a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first means we're both very likely dead before round 2. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than hide it. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now so you can decide with full information. If I get my 4, I'll operate every round afterward to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I'm sorry this breaks the agreement. From now on I will operate every round so the generator runs and you can take your 4 as soon as possible. I won't take anything more.
